acceptance: Red test first: a cycle whose tree has a research dossier row in docs/research-index.md but no entry row (evolve docs index check stale) is refused at the build handoff floor with the exact fix (add the row to its entry file), or the build-derived regen step regenerates every derived file and refuses a hand edit of a generated file.
The check covers each generated file the PR refresh test needs in sync: docs/research-index.md, docs/architecture/signal-codes.md, go/.darwin-set.
fix: Cycle 2112 (commit 7ab5f571d) wrote a row into the generated docs/research-index.md by hand, without its entry file. main then failed `evolve docs index check`, and the CI test TestPRRefresh_TheRealGeneratorsOfACloneCommitOnlyTheStaleIndex failed its precondition on every PR merged with main (PR #1237 went red for it). The build handoff floor or the build-derived regen must run every derived-file check (docs index, signal codes, darwin set) and refuse or repair before ship.
notes: Console route: build floor. Repaired on main by PR #1237 (entry row added).
source: console, 2026-11-02, PR #1237 CI red on TestPRRefresh precondition
summary: A lane shipped a hand edit of a generated index, which turned main stale and made CI red for every PR merged with main.
title: A cycle cannot ship a hand edit of a generated file: the derived-file checks run before ship
